description_zh: 乘客车在直行专用车道违规左转，与左侧相邻车道直行的Waymo AV发生碰撞。选取左转的乘客车为ego，测试其违规左转决策。

source_snippets: the passenger car in the right adjacent lane made a left turn from a straight-only lane onto southeastbound Fourth Street. The rear of the passenger car made contact with the front of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 两车均移动，乘客车违规左转具有测试价值，选其作为ego，与相邻车道直行的Waymo AV（NPC）发生路口转向冲突，现有position和block可表达。
